title: Transforming Cities: Reclaiming Milan’s streets
summary: This C40 case study describes “Transforming Cities: Reclaiming Milan’s streets,” an urban initiative documented for Milan. It is included because it has evidence relevant to children's livelihoods. C40 describes the action this way: A community project in Washington DC that is giving back to locals and ensuring their homes are comfortable and energy efficient.

intervention.objectives: A community project in Washington DC that is giving back to locals and ensuring their homes are comfortable and energy efficient.
intervention.measures:
How Milan’s youth are transforming public spaces one paintbrush at a time 
 As temperatures rise, Milan’s summers are getting hotter, and public spaces are becoming more important than ever. From planting gardens to painting streets, the city is finding creative ways to stay cool and bring back a bit of La Dolce Vita.
